name: Julius Malema
role: Economic Freedom Fighters leader (2013–present); South African parliamentarian
summary: Malema advocates economic emancipation through land redistribution, strategic nationalization and expanded public services. He combines African integration and social-rights commitments with militant rhetoric, including statements the Equality Court found to incite retaliatory violence.

abortion-legal.rationale: He condemned US abortion bans as denying women’s right to choose.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: He demands land and economic redress for the excluded Black majority.

reduce-immigration.rationale: He defends continental free movement despite electoral criticism.

free-trade.rationale: He supports continental free trade while protecting domestic industries against outside competition.

open-borders.rationale: He wants free movement within Africa, comparing it to European integration.

revolution-justified.rationale: In his 2022 speech he expressly justified killing when revolutionary alternatives are exhausted.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Nationalizes rather than abolishes Reserve Bank.

political-violence-never.rationale: He endorsed violent retaliation against racists; the 2025 court rejected his metaphor defense.

equal-outcomes.rationale: He advocates redistributing ownership to remedy racial economic inequality.

direct-action.rationale: His programme treats mass activism and land occupations as foundational alongside elections.

positive-liberty.rationale: He says freedom requires jobs, healthcare, education and basic services.

total-state.rationale: Rejects state control of every industry.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Guarantees basic services regardless of documents.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Equality pledge conflicts with retaliatory rhetoric.

party-commands-army.rationale: Forces owe loyalty to country, not politicians.

death-penalty.rationale: By 2019 he categorically rejected capital punishment, citing wrongful convictions and lack of deterrence.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: He says political freedom without economic emancipation is meaningless.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Aligns monetary policy with industrial development.

land-redistribution.rationale: He promises uncompensated land redistribution, prioritizing women and young people.

delink-world-market.rationale: Pursues exports and international industrial collaboration.

land-use-tenure.rationale: State land with renewable use licences.

corporate-influence.rationale: Demands disclosure of corporate political funding.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Links female emancipation to economic transformation.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: He directly condemned Uganda’s anti-homosexuality legislation.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: He explicitly prefers Russia and the East over neutrality.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: He demands economic control shift from the white minority to the Black majority.

racial-pride.rationale: His 2022 speech explicitly embraces Black consciousness against white supremacy.

keep-colonial-borders.rationale: He rejects African borders drawn by colonial powers.

close-ties-china.rationale: He prefers Eastern partnerships, including China, without excluding Western cooperation.

national-resource-control.rationale: He demands national control of mines, agricultural land and fishing resources.

notes: Full 2024 manifesto, founding programme and 2025 judgment downloaded and searched across all themes. Reviewed all 490 statements and remaining nulls. Foundational commitments are used where retained by the later programme. The 2025 judgment concerns a 2022 speech, separately from the struggle-song litigation: it records the attacks on EFF members, his retaliatory remarks, his metaphor defense and the court’s rejection of that defense. The record is not characterized as a judicial finding of genocide or a general order to kill all white people. His 2009 sexist remarks and 2010 adverse judgment were reviewed; later explicit gender-equality commitments are used. The later rejection of capital punishment supersedes his earlier referendum proposal. Marijuana remarks do not establish legalization of all recreational drugs. Continental free movement does not mean immediate abolition of every border worldwide. General LGBTQ support is not substituted for an explicit marriage policy. No inference from Marxist-Leninist labels, identity, party membership or criminal firearm conduct. Graduate-only job and stipend promises do not establish an unconditional income or job guarantee for everyone. Apartheid monuments would be relocated to a museum, rather than destroyed. Recognition of domestic labour and equal allocation of land-use rights do not settle direct payment for unpaid household work or inheritance rights.
